action_items.text: The Industrial Designer will make a presentation on the components concept for the product.
The User Interface Designer will make a presentation on the user interface concept.
The Marketing Expert will present the marketing concept.
The Project Manager will research companies that can provide the Industrial Designer with help on integrating voice recognition into her design.

decisions.text: The group will discuss which features to include in the final design of the product at the next meeting.
The group will discuss which features to eliminate from the final design of the product at the next meeting.
The remote will have a slim shape.
The remote will have a simple interface.
The remote will include a locator function.
The remote will include voice recognition.
The remote will be made of a hard material.
